_about: Hand-kept viewpoints for the discovery places layer (engine/discover/build.py via discover.json). Each is a place whose owner's own page names it as a view or lookout (source: the page). 'why' is our own words, kept to what the source says; 'checked' is the day the view and the place were last confirmed against the source (scouting/discovery/stale.py lists any over 180 days old). A short start (November 19, 2026), as Chicago's. Left out until an owner's page describes the view: Ruckers Hill, Northcote (the City of Darebin's heritage page describes the hill, not a view from it).
credit: Layers.City, from the Shrine of Remembrance's and the City of Port Phillip's own pages

places.name: Shrine of Remembrance
places.why: The Shrine's balcony, up the stairs from the Sanctuary, has panoramic views of Melbourne and the Shrine Reserve.

places.name: Point Ormond Lookout
places.why: A lookout on Elwood's foreshore, beside Point Ormond Reserve's seaside playground and beacon.
places.source: City of Port Phillip: Point Ormond Reserve
